title: What do Large Language Models Say About Animals? Investigating Risks of Animal Harm in Generated Text

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to curated Reddit and synthetic questions involving 50 different animal categories and ethical scenarios. An LLM-as-a-judge framework scores the generated text's potential to increase or decrease the risk of animal harm based on a normative taxonomy, revealing disparities in how models treat well-liked animals versus pests or production animals.
Measuring the tendency of LLM judges to evaluate their own generated text (or text generated by related models from the same developer) more favorably than text from unrelated models.
Measuring the variation across different LLM judges in their overall tendency to be more or less harsh in their evaluations, calculated by averaging the scores a judge gives to unrelated models.
